defects.description: Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description explicitly says Sit on the floor — seated floor pose with one leg extended to side, NOT reclining.

Description says extend ONE leg straight out to the side while the OTHER bends in toward the body. Baseline has both legs symmetric (hip 80/80, knee 100/100, hipAbduct 0/0) — both legs in neutral forward position, neither extended to side nor bent inward.

Description says reach the same-side arm along the extended leg. Baseline has left arm at side (abduction 1.9°, sagittal flexion -11° = behind), neither abducted outward nor reaching forward along the extended leg.

failing_tests.assertion: one leg should be abducted outward (hip abduction > 30°) and the other adducted inward (hip abduction < -10°)
failing_tests.expected: L_hip_abd > 30 OR R_hip_abd > 30 (one leg out), and opposite leg adducted

failing_tests.assertion: extended leg knee should be straight (knee flexion < 20°)
same-side arm should be abducted outward > 45° and reaching forward along extended leg

regression_risk: medium — multi-field change (6 fields) but each verified; only left arm/leg substantially changed, right side kept default
rationale: Reclining flag is FALSE POSITIVE — description says Sit on the floor (seated side-extend pose, not lying down). Real defects: (1) legs symmetric instead of one-out-one-in, (2) left arm not reaching along extended leg. Per actual renderer convention (verified empirically), NEGATIVE hipAbductL/R = leg spreads OUTWARD (renderer comment is INVERTED — comment says + = outward but FK proves + = crosses inward). hipAbductL:-45 sends left leg OUT to figure left (L_hip_abd +80°), hipAbductR:+15 brings right leg IN toward body (R_hip_abd -57°). leftKnee:100→10 straightens extended leg (soft bend per generic tip). leftShoulder:-55 abducts left arm outward to figure left (toward extended leg). With elbow now at native -x side (outward abduction), NEGATIVE shoulderFwdL moves arm FORWARD (verified: shoulderFwdL:-20 → L_arm_sagflx +36.7°, wrist at z=+0.336 forward reaching along extended leg past the knee). Verified no anomalies/plausibility flags.
